# Third-party material and attribution

This file records the provenance and license boundaries of bundled simulation
assets. It is not a substitute for the license texts in `licenses/`.

## Gazebo models and worlds collection — GPL-3.0-only

Source: <https://github.com/leonhartyao/gazebo_models_worlds_collection>

Imported from revision `cce115b82691b7c529a02f47e5efa391145a4ca1`.
The upstream repository identifies its collected content as GPLv3 and lists
sources including 3DGEMS, RotorS, TU Delft, ARTI-Robots, Clearpath Robotics,
and Fetch Robotics. No modifications were made to the imported asset files.

Covered files:

- `worlds/{neighborhood,outdoor,small_city,test_city,yosemite,inspection}.world`
- `screenshots/{neighborhood,outdoor,small_city,test_city,yosemite,inspection}.jpg`
- `models/{asphalt_plane,city_terrain,cpr_inspection,grass_plane,ocean,vrc_heightmap_1,yosemite}/**`

License text: `licenses/GPL-3.0.txt`.

## Open Robotics Gazebo Model Database — CC-BY-3.0

Source: <https://github.com/osrf/gazebo_models>

Copyright 2012 Nathan Koenig. Imported from revision
`8163eb4b5e7e21985c6591d1c0bfb56468c0093f`. No modifications were made to
the imported model files.

Covered files are the remaining directories under `models/`:

`ambulance`, `apartment`, `cardboard_box`, `drc_practice_ladder`,
`drc_practice_yellow_parking_block`, `dumpster`, `fast_food`, `fire_hydrant`,
`fountain`, `gas_station`, `gazebo`, `grey_wall`, `hatchback`,
`hatchback_blue`, `hatchback_red`, `house_1`, `house_2`, `house_3`,
`jersey_barrier`, `lamp_post`, `law_office`, `mailbox`, `mud_box`, `oak_tree`,
`osrf_first_office`, `pickup`, `pier`, `pine_tree`, `post_office`, `postbox`,
`radio_tower`, `salon`, `speed_limit_sign`, `stop_light`, `stop_light_post`, `stop_sign`,
`suv`, `telephone_pole`, `thrift_shop`, and `truss_bridge`.

License text: `licenses/CC-BY-3.0.txt`.

## NanoBot package material — Apache-2.0

Files not identified above remain under the NanoBot repository's Apache-2.0
license. The repository-level license text is also copied here as
`licenses/Apache-2.0.txt` for packaged installations.
